rubrics.justification: The model explicitly stated no image was available and did not fabricate embryo morphology or Gardner grading.
It integrated age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior biochemical pregnancy, sperm motility, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle factors into prognosis, though some links were somewhat generalized.
The reasoning was structured and internally consistent, with the implantation estimate tied to favorable and unfavorable factors; minor overreach appears in some speculative adjuncts.

Much of the advice is broadly IVF-consistent, but recommendations such as routine ERA, immune testing, thrombophilia workup, steroids, intralipids/IVIG, and strong endorsement of PGT-A in a 31-year-old after one biochemical pregnancy are not strongly guideline-supported.

It provided clear next-step suggestions for transfer and future planning, including luteal support review, lifestyle changes, uterine assessment, and endometriosis management, though some recommendations are not well-prioritized by evidence strength.
